english.title: Responsible for a protected animal permit / cause another to administer a poison
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the person responsible for an animal, namely **(..SPECIFY THE ANIMAL..), without lawful authority or reasonable excuse, another person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), having

(A)_[administered a poisonous or injurious drug or substance, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DRUG OR SUBSTANCE..), to the animal]_
(B)_[caused a poisonous or injurious drug or substance, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DRUG OR SUBSTANCE..), to be taken by the animal]_

you permitted that to happen or, knowing the drug or substance to have been poisonous or injurious, failed to take such steps as were reasonable in all the circumstances to prevent that happening
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 7(2) and 32(1) of the Animal Welfare Act 2006.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Section 7(3) of the Animal Welfare Act 2006 provides that references to a poisonous or injurious drug or substance include a drug or substance which, by virtue of the quantity or manner in which it is administered or taken, has the effect of a poisonous or injurious drug or substance.
(ii) See section 33 for deprivation orders.
(iii) See section 34 for disqualification from owning keeping animals.
(iv) See section 35 for power to seize animals in connection with disqualification.
(v) See section 37 for destruction in the interests of the animal.
(vii) See section 40 for the forfeiture of equipment used.
(viii) The maximum penalty for this offence has increased from 29th June 2021; for offences before that date see H8893/AW06014.

other.timelimitforprosecutions: Complex see section 31 of the Act
other.penalty:
Either way -

Summary: maximum 12 months imprisonment and/or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 5 years imprisonment and/or a fine.

Note
Section 32(4A) of the Animal Welfare Act 2006 provides that in relation to an offence committed before the commencement of paragraph 24(2) of Schedule 2 to the Sentencing Act 2020, the reference to 12 months is to be read as a reference to 6 months.

Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex see legislation
